sentences.text: `` Shut Up '' is a song by English Grime artist and MC Stormzy .	Stormzy	Stormzy
The song was released independently for digital download in the United Kingdom on 11 September 2015 as the B-side to the `` WickedSkengMan 4 '' single .	United Kingdom	United Kingdom
It was produced by XTC and written by Stormzy .	Stormzy	Stormzy
`` Shut Up '' was originally released as a freestyle video in May 2015 but gained popularity over the year .

The song initially entered at number 59 on the UK Singles Chart in September 2015 , however following a Christmas number one campaign the song rose to number 8 .	UK Singles Chart	UK Singles Chart	Christmas number one	List of UK Singles Chart Christmas number ones
